basic_info.description: Welcome to 25 Rolph Street, a charming home in San Francisco that's been thoughtfully renovated with over $125,000 in improvements. This spacious residence offers 5 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms across 2,035 square feet, providing ample space for comfortable living.    The upper level features three inviting bedrooms and a full bathroom, ideal for family life. Downstairs, what was originally a den/library from 1971 has been transformed into a versatile space with two bedrooms, a large full bath, and a kitchen-dining-family combo room. This non-conforming area spans 785 square feet but feels even larger when the sliding doors open to the expansive green lawn and private backyard.    The attached one-car garage, at 400 square feet, offers plenty of room for parking and potential additional craft space. Plans are underway to convert the lower section into an ADU, with drawings already accepted.
